lessons.title: Lesson 1: Ecotourism & Travel Vocabulary
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Ecotourism & Travel Vocabulary.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Type 1: Real and possible in present/future (If + Present Simple, will + V-bare). Type 2: Unreal or hypothetical in present/future (If + Past Simple [were for all persons], would + V-bare).
concepts.example: If tourists leave trash, they will damage the coral reef (Type 1). If I had more free time, I would join an eco-tour in Phong Nha (Type 2).
concepts.essence: Probability separates real conditions (Type 1) from imaginary counterfactual hypotheses (Type 2).

rules.meaning: In formal English, the subjunctive 'were' is used for all persons (I/he/she/it were) in the If-clause.
rules.example: If I were you, I would choose an eco-friendly homestay.

workedExamples.prompt: Put verbs into correct form (Conditional Type 2): 'If people (care) more about nature, our planet (not be) in danger.'
steps: Step 1: If-clause uses Past Simple: cared.
Step 2: Main clause uses would + V-bare: would not be.

commonMistakes.mistake: Putting 'will' or 'would' inside the If-clause (writing 'If it will rain' or 'If I would have money').
commonMistakes.why: Modal auxiliaries will/would belong in the main result clause, never in the conditional If-clause.
